name: Balor Wings
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

Components: V, S, M (a bat wing and a piece of sulfur)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Personal

Target(s): You

Duration: 1 min./level

Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

This spell is similar to fly, except that the caster grows bat-wings made of fire that he may use to attack when not flying, and maximum flying speed is 30 ft. with no penalty for carrying a heavy load. Attacks with both wings count as a single melee touch attack with a 10 ft. reach and a +1 bonus to hit. The wings cause a total of 1d8 points of fire damage +1 point per two caster levels (maximum +15). Since the wings are immaterial, your Strength modifier does not apply to the damage.
